2026_01_NO_DET.headline: Detroit gets a trench opportunity as New Orleans loses Cameron Jordan and monitors Kamara
2026_01_NO_DET.paragraph1: The Saints ruled Cameron Jordan, Oscar Delp and Audric Estimé out, and Alvin Kamara is questionable despite finishing the week as a full practice participant. The Lions list only Christian Izien as questionable. New Orleans can still threaten Detroit if Kamara is available and the offense stays balanced, but the larger matchup pressure falls on a Saints defense missing Jordan. Detroit can attack that absence with protection flexibility, downhill runs and play-action that makes the remaining New Orleans front defend every gap.
2026_01_NO_DET.model_rationale: Detroit owns the stronger structural setup because New Orleans must replace a premier edge presence while also managing uncertainty around a central offensive playmaker.
